scope: Same-page ratings, favourite choice, optional name, per-design comments and overall comment. Existing imagery unchanged.
backend: Existing Sites D1 database; additive rating_responses table. No change to ballots table or its API.
privacy: First-party browser localStorage random 256-bit response token, hashed server-side; no credentials in source. Exact-origin CORS; no public response listing.

checks.backend_integration: Passed local persistence, update, withdrawal, isolation between response keys, disallowed origins, missing token, invalid/duplicate/out-of-range ratings and overlong comments.
checks.browser: Local same-page save, restore after reload, update and withdrawal passed; all test responses removed. Twelve cards at 390px; no horizontal overflow.

limits: No public comment feed; comments remain private.
No automatic import of earlier cookie-based shortlist votes.
No invitation sent or timed survey launched.
